Name: Katherine DeBoer
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

Interpreting Visual Texts feels most immediately usable in my teaching context. I teach about the geography and economy of each civilization that we study. Incorporating geographical maps and economic data charts would naturally fit into the curriculum.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
I have used 'stop and jot' to encourage the students to write down what they learned that lesson. We also do quick writes to access prior knowledge before beginning a new topic. It is challenging to for some students to understand that quick writes don't need to be perfect. They often want to know if their answer is correct. I also need to stop and slow down and give time for writing activities.
